body:
The Pure Copper Braided Bracelet is your everyday anchor, the piece that works in the background of everything else you wear. Hand braided from pure copper, it's designed to be worn constantly, never taken off, becoming more attuned to you the longer it stays on your wrist.

Copper has been used for centuries as a conductive metal, and that quality is exactly what makes this bracelet different. It doesn't just sit on your skin, it moves energy through it, amplifying and extending the charge of any crystal or frequency piece worn alongside it. Wear it stacked with your favorite stones and let the copper deepen what they're already doing.

Woven into the design are embedded magnets, added to support balance within your body's own electromagnetic field. Together, copper's conductivity and the magnets' steady pull create a stronger, more centered field than either could hold alone, helping to keep scattered or static energy grounded throughout your day.

This is a piece built for consistency, not ritual. There's no charging window, no recalibrating, no taking it off to reset. It's designed to stay on through your workday, your workout, your everyday movement, quietly doing its work at your wrist while you go about your life.

Wear it alone as your daily grounding piece, or stack it with your 174Hz Frequency Bracelet, Aquamarine Bracelet, or Tourmalinated Quartz Bracelet to amplify their energy even further. However you wear it, this bracelet is designed to become part of your everyday rhythm, the one constant in an otherwise shifting stack.

This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
